p: Provides methods to manage the entry and exit of layout node contexts within a UI rendering or layout system.
Enters the specified layout node's scope and begins managing its state or properties.

ul.li: node (LayoutNode): The layout node to enter and manage within a new scope.
A LayoutNodeScope representing the entered scope of the given layout node.

p: Exits the current layout node's scope and returns the parent layout node, if any.

ul.li: The parent layout node after exiting the current scope.
